description: Annual number of deliveries in NHS hospitals in England from Hospital Episode Statistics.

resource_name: Indexed change in deliveries by age group, 2014-15 to 2024-25
description: Indexed change in the number of deliveries by maternal age group, where 2014-15 equals 100.
measure_name: Index change in number of deliveries

resource_name: Deliveries by method of onset, 2014-15 to 2024-25
description: Percentage of deliveries with a known method of onset classified as caesarean, spontaneous or induced. Deliveries with an unknown method are excluded; annual percentages may not total exactly 100 because of rounding.
measure_name: Percentage of deliveries by method of onset

resource_name: Anaesthetic or analgesic use by age group, 2014-15 and 2024-25
description: Percentage of deliveries involving anaesthetic or analgesic use before or during delivery, by maternal age group. For 2024-25, the source includes 'other' and excludes n/a values.
measure_name: Percentage of deliveries with anaesthetic or analgesic use

resource_name: Method of delivery by maternal age group, 2024-25
description: Percentage of deliveries with a known method of delivery classified as spontaneous, instrumental or caesarean, by maternal age group. Deliveries with an unknown method are excluded; percentages may total 99 to 101 because of rounding.
measure_name: Percentage of deliveries by method of delivery

description: Five most prevalent delivery complications recorded on finished delivery episodes in NHS hospitals in England, presented by ICD-10 code and percentage of all delivery episodes. A delivery may have no recorded complication or more than one, so percentages must not be summed.
measure_name: Percentage of delivery episodes with complication

resource_name: Method of delivery by postnatal stay duration, 2024-25
description: Percentage distribution of known postnatal-stay durations within each known method of delivery. Postnatal stay is measured from the first baby's birth to the end of the finished delivery episode; durations over 270 days or null are classified as unknown and excluded.
measure_name: Percentage of deliveries by postnatal stay duration

description: Percentage distribution of deliveries with a recorded baby birthweight across six weight bands. Birthweight is measured immediately after birth and only the first birth record is considered; values above 7000 grams or null are excluded as unknown.
measure_name: Percentage of deliveries by recorded baby birthweight

resource_name: Five-minute Apgar score for live-born term babies, 2024-25
description: Numbers and percentages of distinct live-born term babies by five-minute Apgar score group. Term births have a gestation length of 259 to 315 days. Missing or invalid scores are excluded from percentages; baby counts are rounded to the nearest five and percentages are calculated from rounded counts.
measure_name: Five-minute Apgar score group for live-born term babies

resource_name: Skin-to-skin contact within one hour for term babies, 2024-25
description: Numbers and percentages of distinct term babies by whether they had skin-to-skin contact with their mother within one hour of birth. Term births have a gestation length of 259 to 315 days. Missing or invalid contact status is excluded from percentages; counts are rounded to the nearest five.
measure_name: Skin-to-skin contact within one hour of birth
